theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 56 群

items.colloc: pointed remark 尖銳的評論 | pointed question 針對性的問題
items.distinct: sharp 銳利的 | articulate 善表達的
ex: She made a pointed comment about the budget cuts.
她針對預算削減發表了尖銳的評論。
The manager asked a pointed question regarding our performance.
經理針對我們的表現提出了一個尖銳的問題。
He gave a pointed reminder about the upcoming deadline.
他針對即將到期的期限給出了明確的提醒。

items.colloc: in possession of 持有 | personal possessions 個人物品
items.distinct: property 資產；房地產 | ownership 所有權
ex: The company is now in possession of the land.
該公司目前擁有這塊土地。
Please ensure all personal possessions are kept safe.
請確保所有個人物品都妥善保管。
They are fighting for legal possession of the trademark.
他們正在爭取商標的合法所有權。

items.colloc: potentially dangerous 潛在危險的 | potentially profitable 潛在獲利的
items.distinct: possibly 可能地 | likely 可能地
ex: This new technology is potentially a huge market winner.
這項新技術可能成為市場上的大贏家。
We identified several potentially risky areas in the project.
我們發現了專案中幾個潛在的風險領域。
The merger is potentially beneficial for both companies.
這項合併對兩家公司都有潛在的好處。

items.colloc: precisely at 恰好在 | work precisely 精確地工作
items.distinct: exactly 正好 | accurately 準確地
ex: The meeting will start precisely at ten o'clock.
會議將在十點整準時開始。
This is precisely what we need to increase sales.
這正是我們增加銷售額所需要的。
They calculated the costs quite precisely last week.
他們上週非常精確地計算了成本。

items.colloc: speak privately 私下談話 | privately owned 私有的
items.distinct: confidentially 機密地 | secretly 秘密地
ex: I would like to discuss this matter with you privately.
我想和你私下討論這件事。
He prefers to handle sensitive issues privately.
他偏好私下處理敏感問題。
The company is privately held by three major investors.
這家公司由三位主要投資者私人持有。

items.colloc: date of publication 出版日期 | academic publication 學術刊物
items.distinct: publishing 出版業 | announcement 公告
ex: The annual report is ready for official publication.
年度報告已準備好正式發布。
He writes articles for a professional industry publication.
他為一份專業行業刊物撰寫文章。
The book's publication was delayed due to technical issues.
這本書的出版因技術問題而延遲。

items.colloc: large quantity 大量 | supply in quantity 大量供應
items.distinct: amount 總額；總量 | quality 品質
ex: We need to order a large quantity of supplies.
我們需要訂購大量的用品。
The quality is just as important as the quantity.
品質與數量同樣重要。
They offer discounts for purchases in large quantities.
他們為大量採購提供折扣。

items.pos: v. 回憶起；召回（產品） | n. 記憶力；召回
items.colloc: product recall 產品召回 | recall an incident 回憶起事件
items.distinct: remember 記得 | withdraw 撤回
ex: The manufacturer issued a recall for the defective cars.
製造商針對瑕疵車輛發布了召回公告。
I cannot recall the details of our last meeting.
我無法回憶起上次會議的細節。
The company had to recall the entire batch of products.
公司不得不召回整批產品。

items.colloc: in recognition of 以表彰 | brand recognition 品牌知名度
items.distinct: acknowledgment 承認 | identification 識別
ex: He received an award in recognition of his service.
他因卓越表現而獲得表彰獎項。
Building brand recognition is vital for our new product.
建立品牌知名度對我們的新產品至關重要。
The company gained international recognition for innovation.
這家公司因創新而獲得國際認可。

items.colloc: flat refusal 直接拒絕 | point-blank refusal 斷然拒絕
items.distinct: rejection 駁回；排斥 | denial 否認
ex: His refusal to cooperate surprised the entire board.
他拒絕合作讓整個董事會感到意外。
They received a formal refusal from the bank yesterday.
他們昨天收到銀行的正式拒絕通知。
The management gave no reason for their refusal.
管理層對他們的拒絕未給出任何理由。

items.colloc: highly relevant 非常相關的 | relevant experience 相關經驗
items.distinct: pertinent 有關的 | applicable 適用的
ex: Please provide all relevant documents for the application.
請提供申請所需的所有相關文件。
The data you provided is not relevant to our project.
你提供的數據與我們的專案不相關。
He has relevant experience in the marketing department.
他在行銷部門擁有相關經驗。

items.colloc: send a reminder 發送提醒 | email reminder 電子郵件提醒
items.distinct: notice 公告 | memo 備忘錄
ex: This is a friendly reminder regarding your invoice payment.
這是關於您發票付款的溫馨提醒。
I set a reminder to call the client tomorrow.
我設定了提醒明天要打電話給客戶。
She sent a reminder email about the project deadline.
她寄了一封關於專案截止日期的提醒郵件。

items.colloc: rewarding experience 有意義的經驗 | rewarding job 值得做的工作
items.distinct: profitable 有利可圖的 | satisfactory 滿意的
ex: Teaching is a very rewarding career for many people.
對許多人來說，教學是一份很有成就感的工作。
We had a rewarding discussion about future strategies.
我們針對未來策略進行了非常有意義的討論。
The project was difficult but ultimately very rewarding.
這項專案很困難，但最終非常有價值。

items.pos: adv. 荒謬地；極其（非正式）
items.colloc: ridiculously low 極低的 | ridiculously expensive 貴得離譜
items.distinct: absurdly 荒謬地 | extremely 極端地
ex: The prices at that restaurant are ridiculously high.
那家餐廳的價格貴得離譜。
It was ridiculously easy to install the new software.
安裝這套新軟體簡直太容易了。
They submitted a ridiculously short deadline for us.
他們給我們設定了極其短的截止期限。

items.pos: n. 方案；計畫 | v. 策劃
items.colloc: marketing scheme 行銷方案 | pension scheme 退休金計畫
items.distinct: plan 計畫 | strategy 策略
ex: The government introduced a new scheme to support startups.
政府推出了一項新方案來支持新創企業。
He is designing a scheme to optimize production efficiency.
他正在設計一個優化生產效率的方案。
They are participating in the company's pension scheme.
他們正在參加公司的退休金計畫。

items.colloc: run smoothly 運作順利 | proceed smoothly 進行順利
items.distinct: fluidly 流暢地 | easily 容易地
ex: Everything went smoothly during the international conference.
國際會議期間一切進行得很順利。
The new system is running smoothly after the update.
系統更新後運作得非常順暢。
We need to ensure the transition happens smoothly.
我們需要確保過渡期能順利進行。

items.pos: v. 分裂；分開 | n. 分歧；分裂
items.colloc: split the cost 平分費用 | split into groups 分成小組
items.distinct: divide 分割 | separate 分離
ex: Let us split the cost of the lunch evenly.
我們把午餐費用平分吧。
The committee was split on the new policy decision.
委員會對新政策決定的意見產生了分歧。
They decided to split the project into three phases.
他們決定將專案分成三個階段。

items.colloc: rise steeply 急遽上升 | decline steeply 急遽下降
items.distinct: sharply 急遽地 | dramatically 戲劇性地
ex: Sales have risen steeply over the last quarter.
上一季的銷售額急遽上升。
The path leads steeply up to the main office.
這條小路陡峭地通往總辦公室。
Market share declined steeply after the new competitor arrived.
新競爭對手出現後，市占率急遽下降。

items.pos: adj. 僵硬的；激烈的；嚴厲的
items.colloc: stiff competition 激烈的競爭 | stiff penalty 嚴厲的懲罰
items.distinct: rigid 僵硬的 | severe 嚴重的
ex: We are facing stiff competition from international firms.
我們正面臨來自國際企業的激烈競爭。
The company faces a stiff penalty for violating safety rules.
公司因違反安全規定面臨嚴厲懲罰。
He has a stiff neck from working at the desk.
他在辦公桌前工作導致脖子僵硬。

items.colloc: core strength 核心優勢 | financial strength 財務實力
items.distinct: power 力量 | force 武力；力量
ex: Our company's main strength is our innovative team.
我們公司的主要優勢在於我們創新的團隊。
They are focusing on increasing their financial strength.
他們正致力於增強財務實力。
The building was designed for structural strength.
這棟建築在設計上注重結構強度。
